cards.title: Raw data is hard to read
cards.idea: A long list of unsorted values is called raw data, and it is difficult to make sense of at a glance.

interaction.prompt: Tap the list of marks to try to spot how many students scored 7

cards.reveal: The marks 5, 7, 6, 7, 8, 5, 7, 6, 9, 7 are jumbled, so you have to hunt through the whole list to count the 7s

cards.title: Tally marks help you count
cards.idea: A tally mark is a small stroke you make each time a value appears; the fifth stroke crosses the first four, forming groups of five.

interaction.prompt: Tap each 7 in the list to add a tally stroke for it

cards.reveal: Four upright strokes and one crossing stroke show that 7 appears four times, written as one group of five would be, but here you get four strokes

cards.title: The frequency table
cards.idea: When you count how many times each value occurs, that count is its frequency, and arranging values with their frequencies makes a frequency table.

interaction.prompt: Tap a row to see the value, its tally, and its frequency lined up

cards.reveal: Value 7 has a tally of four strokes and a frequency of 4, so the table turns raw data into an ordered summary

cards.title: Grouping into class intervals
cards.idea: When there are many different values, you group them into equal ranges called class intervals to keep the table short.

interaction.prompt: Drag the mark 27 into the correct interval among 0-10, 10-20, 20-30

cards.reveal: 27 falls into the 20-30 interval; grouping lets you summarise a wide spread of values into a few neat rows

cards.title: Reading the grouped table
cards.idea: Each row of a grouped table tells you how many data values fall inside that interval, which helps you compare ranges quickly.

interaction.prompt: Tap the interval that has the highest frequency in the table shown

cards.reveal: The 20-30 interval has frequency 8, the largest, so most values lie in that range

workbook.prompt: In a frequency table, what does the frequency of a value tell you?
options: How many times that value occurs
The largest value in the data
The sum of all the values
workbook.answer: How many times that value occurs

workbook.prompt: A small stroke made each time a value appears while counting is called a ________ mark.
Equal ranges used to group many different data values are called

boss.prompt: For the marks 12, 18, 25, 9, 27, 14, 3, using intervals 0-10, 10-20, 20-30, which interval has frequency 3?
If a value of 30 must go into either the interval 20-30 or 30-40, the usual rule places it in the interval ________.
A frequency table shows shoe sizes with frequencies: size 5 is 3, size 6 is 7, size 7 is 5, size 8 is 2. Which size is worn by the most students?
